rows.20:7484:
...Hm?
Is this a message from your past life?
Maybe you've been cheeky ever since your past life.
Hmmm...
A cheeky man...
rows.20:7520:
Maybe you were a prince of some country...
...No, it hasn't been settled that clearly yet.
But it might be close...
Even if you weren't a prince, though.
You could've been a prince's aide, or his pet...
Or an ingredient in a dish served at the prince's table...
Those possibilities are all still open.
...You don't believe me?
All right!
Then I'll read your fortune in even more detail☆{p}
rows.20:799c:
Traveling, huh?
You do love that sort of thing, don't you?
...You're out to pick up girls, right?
I know all about it.
No, you don't have to hide it.
I think I've got your personality figured out.
You seem like a simple guy.
The fortune says so too.
In your past life, you must have been a pretty simple fellow too.
Well, don't let it get you down.
Even if your past life was nothing special, you can just try hard from now on.
Of course, some people never get rewarded however hard they try.
...Why the sulky face?
Are you feeling gloomy now?
Then how about I blow that mood away for you?
As a special treat, just for you, since you chose the Special Course, I'll teach you a marvelous charm.{p}
rows.20:80ec:
"No way... I'd never say that, not even if you tore my mouth open!"
When I stood my ground...{p}
rows.20:8488:
...Or so I thought, but then he suddenly grinned and said this:
"{a}... I can see your past life clearly now.
It's really hard to say, but..."
Kazama wore a spiteful smile.
What is with this guy?
He's not going to say something nasty because he's mad I ignored him, is he?{p}
rows.20:8780:
Whoa!
You've got pretty sharp intuition!
Your past life was a sea slug.
Phew, I'm so glad
you guessed it.
It would've been a bit hard to say something like that myself.{p}
rows.20:89e4:
...Actually, you're exactly right.
You were a sea anemone drifting in swarms in a certain sea.
I even know your name.
You were called Anemone Jack.
You were a really cute sea anemone.
After you died, you became beautiful coral and ended up as a necklace for the queen of a certain country.
You played a starring role, you know.
...That's a lie.
The Anemone Jack part is true, though.
The coral necklace and the starring role are the big lies.
Ha ha ha...
From birth to death, you were just Anemone Jack.
rows.20:8eac:
Hmmmmm?
What are you talking about?
I read your past life correctly, you know.
It's not nice to take that attitude just because you didn't like the result.{p}
